# Dialog

A modal dialog component with a structured header (title + optional subtitle + X close button), a scrollable content area, and a footer with cancel and confirm actions.

```ts
import { Dialog } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Basic Usage

`visible` controls whether the dialog is open. `onClose` is called by the X button, the cancel button, and the backdrop click. `onConfirm` is called when the confirm button is clicked.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Flex padding="4" alignX="center">
      <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setVisible(true)}>
        Open Dialog
      </Button>

      <Dialog
        visible={visible}
        title="Daily Meeting"
        onClose={() => setVisible(false)}
        onConfirm={() => setVisible(false)}
      >
        <Typography variant="body">
          Configure the details for this meeting event before saving. All
          participants will be notified once the event is confirmed.
        </Typography>
      </Dialog>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## With Subtitle

Pass `subtitle` to render a muted secondary line below the title — useful for timestamps, record identifiers, or supporting context.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Flex padding="4" alignX="center">
      <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setVisible(true)}>
        Open Dialog with Subtitle
      </Button>

      <Dialog
        visible={visible}
        title="Daily Meeting"
        subtitle="Created at 05:44 AM, Apr 20, 2026"
        onClose={() => setVisible(false)}
        onConfirm={() => setVisible(false)}
      >
        <Typography variant="body">
          Review the meeting details. The subtitle above provides the creation
          timestamp for this event.
        </Typography>
      </Dialog>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

Use `size` to control the dialog width. The three presets map directly to Cobalt Modal sizes: `'small'` for brief confirmations, `'medium'` (default) for standard forms, and `'large'` for complex content.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [openSize, setOpenSize] = useState(null);

  return (
    <Flex gap="3" padding="4" alignX="center">
      {['small', 'medium', 'large'].map((s) => (
        <Button key={s} type="secondary" onClick={() => setOpenSize(s)}>
          {s}
        </Button>
      ))}

      {['small', 'medium', 'large'].map((s) => (
        <Dialog
          key={s}
          visible={openSize === s}
          title={`${s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)} Dialog`}
          subtitle={`size="${s}"`}
          size={s}
          onClose={() => setOpenSize(null)}
          onConfirm={() => setOpenSize(null)}
        >
          <Typography variant="body">This is a {s}-sized dialog.</Typography>
        </Dialog>
      ))}
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Danger Variant

Set `confirmButtonType="danger"` for destructive actions. Combine with `messages` to override the default button labels.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Flex padding="4" alignX="center">
      <Button type="danger" onClick={() => setVisible(true)}>
        Delete Schedule
      </Button>

      <Dialog
        visible={visible}
        title="Delete Schedule"
        subtitle="This action cannot be undone"
        size="small"
        confirmButtonType="danger"
        messages={{ confirmLabel: 'Delete', cancelLabel: 'Keep it' }}
        onClose={() => setVisible(false)}
        onConfirm={() => setVisible(false)}
      >
        <Typography variant="body">
          Are you sure you want to permanently delete this schedule? All
          associated shifts and assignments will be removed.
        </Typography>
      </Dialog>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Confirm Loading State

Set `isConfirmLoading` to `true` while an async operation is in progress. The confirm button switches to an inline spinner and becomes non-interactive until you set it back to `false`.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setLoading(false);
      setVisible(false);
    }, 2000);
  };

  return (
    <Flex padding="4" alignX="center">
      <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setVisible(true)}>
        Save Meeting
      </Button>

      <Dialog
        visible={visible}
        title="Save Meeting"
        subtitle="Changes will be applied to all future occurrences"
        isConfirmLoading={loading}
        messages={{ confirmLabel: 'Save' }}
        onClose={() => !loading && setVisible(false)}
        onConfirm={handleConfirm}
      >
        <Typography variant="body">
          Click Save to apply your changes. The confirm button shows a loading
          state while the request is in progress.
        </Typography>
      </Dialog>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Disabled Confirm

Set `isConfirmDisabled={true}` to prevent the user from submitting the dialog — useful when form validation is incomplete. The confirm button is grayed out and non-interactive; the cancel button remains active.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [agreed, setAgreed] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Flex padding="4" alignX="center">
      <Button
        type="primary"
        onClick={() => {
          setVisible(true);
          setAgreed(false);
        }}
      >
        Open Dialog
      </Button>

      <Dialog
        visible={visible}
        title="Accept Terms"
        subtitle="You must accept before continuing"
        isConfirmDisabled={!agreed}
        messages={{ confirmLabel: 'Accept &amp; Continue' }}
        onClose={() => setVisible(false)}
        onConfirm={() => setVisible(false)}
      >
        <Flex direction="column" gap="3">
          <Typography variant="body">
            Review the terms below before proceeding.
          </Typography>
          <label style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={agreed}
              onChange={(e) => setAgreed(e.target.checked)}
            />
            I accept the terms and conditions
          </label>
        </Flex>
      </Dialog>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop                | Type                                   | Default       | Description                                                                                |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `visible`           | `boolean`                              | —             | Controls dialog visibility                                                                 |
| `onClose`           | `() => void`                           | —             | Called when X button, cancel button, or backdrop is clicked                                |
| `onConfirm`         | `() => void`                           | —             | Called when the confirm button is clicked                                                  |
| `title`             | `string`                               | —             | Primary heading in the dialog header                                                       |
| `subtitle`          | `string`                               | —             | Optional muted secondary line below the title                                              |
| `children`          | `ReactNode`                            | —             | Dialog body content — scrolls if it overflows                                              |
| `size`              | `'small' \| 'medium' \| 'large'`       | `'medium'`    | Dialog width preset                                                                        |
| `confirmButtonType` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'danger'` | `'primary'`   | Visual style of the confirm button                                                         |
| `isConfirmLoading`  | `boolean`                              | `false`       | Shows an inline loading spinner on the confirm button                                      |
| `isConfirmDisabled` | `boolean`                              | `false`       | Disables the confirm button                                                                |
| `messages`          | `DialogMessages`                       | —             | Override user-visible labels — see table below                                             |
| `data-qa`           | `string`                               | —             | QA selector prefix. Suffixes: `-cancel-button`, `-confirm-button`, `-content`, `-subtitle` |
| `data-component`    | `string`                               | `'WFMDialog'` | Component identifier                                                                       |

## DialogMessages

| Field          | Type     | Default     | Description          |
| -------------- | -------- | ----------- | -------------------- |
| `cancelLabel`  | `string` | `'Cancel'`  | Cancel button label  |
| `confirmLabel` | `string` | `'Confirm'` | Confirm button label |
